note: Synthetic no-op B3 (RL) mock: it contributes a real burst-stage damage profile so control comps aren't missing the B3 nuke entirely. On its own burst cast it gains +200% Attack Damage (3× total) for 10s, covering the Full Burst it initiates; it does not get the buff on rotations where a different B3 bursts. The multiplier is intentionally simple and does not replace a real unit's kit.
